title: Thread-safety bug: `LogBufferingFilterRuleSelector.Select` races with `InvalidateCache`, causing `InvalidOperationException - Collection was modified; enumeration operation may not execute`
verifier_note: api.github.com and github.com are 403 in this sandbox; the r.jina.ai markdown view held only the issue body, so the page was re-read as HTML (r.jina.ai X-Return-Format: html) and the embedded GraphQL payload was parsed: state OPEN, assignedActors [], closedByPullRequestsReferences [], 'No one assigned', 'No branches or pull requests', timeline hasNextPage=false with all items loaded, no IssueComment and no cross-referenced PR items.
